note: Review scenarios, not wire payloads or executed product tests. Canonical contract controls semantics.

scenarios.expected: Verified session joins a scoped board; accepted edit commits before ACK.
HTTP, WSS and bot foreign selectors are denied with no protected disclosure or mutation.
HTTP, WSS and bot forged writes are denied without revision or event.
Expired or revoked session denies new commands and queued protected delivery on HTTP, WSS and bot.
Revoke ordered before release suppresses live, replay, snapshot, receipt and ACK; a prior commit remains durable on HTTP, WSS and bot.
Rollback before commit yields no accepted ACK; after possible commit keep outcome unknown and retry identical operation.
A matching receipt may be returned with current read access after write authority is lost; no new write.
Retained historical receipt settles original acceptance only, never replays or saves restored state; missing old receipt rejects old intent.
A partial snapshot is not promoted; reauthorize and recover.
Quarantine incomplete upload; no finalized asset or false saved state.
Stale or missing membership, policy or trusted time fails closed for write and protected release.
Prevent startup or affected capability without secret disclosure.
Verified bot moderation uses shared command service and the same serialized policy fence as Activity commands.
Digest conflict is released only with current read authority and creates no mutation.
A release ordered before revocation may complete; already emitted bytes cannot be recalled.
